item.subject: science
item.chapter_label: The world of metals and non-metals
item.stem: Meena's teacher asks the class: 'We see metals everywhere — in our pressure cookers, cycles and ceiling fans. Are metals the only substances important in everyday life?' Which student gives the most correct answer?

options.A: Ravi: Yes, because only metals are used to make useful things in the home.
options.B: Sunita: No, non-metals are also essential — oxygen is needed for breathing, nitrogen is used in fertilisers, and chlorine is used to purify drinking water.
options.C: Arjun: Yes, because every non-metal around us is important in everyday life.
options.D: Farah: Yes, because nitrogen is used to purify drinking water.
